summary: Triages a compound set from raw file to a ranked, domain-gated shortlist: structure standardisation and deduplication, PAINS and structural-alert screening, descriptors and fingerprints, similarity clustering and scaffold-series analysis, ADMET liability assessment, and QSAR with an explicit applicability-domain gate and honest validation. Does not plan syntheses or enumerate reactions.
